Purpose: Dowload gtex data (counts and metadata) and choose subset of patients
Input: Gtex portal download links
Ouput: 
- data/raw/samples_and_subjects_clean_subset.RData
- data/raw/counts_subset.RData

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

# loading data

Load data from the gtex portal
Counts are from left ventricule samples
This is gtex v11, reads were aligned on gencode v47 which uses ensembl release 113
```{r}
counts <- read_tsv("https://storage.googleapis.com/adult-gtex/bulk-gex/v11/rna-seq/counts-by-tissue/gene_reads_adult_gtex_v11_heart_left_ventricle.gct.gz", skip=2)
samples <- read_tsv("https://storage.googleapis.com/adult-gtex/annotations/v11/metadata-files/GTEx_Analysis_v11_Annotations_SampleAttributesDS.txt")
subjects <- read_tsv("https://storage.googleapis.com/adult-gtex/annotations/v11/metadata-files/GTEx_Analysis_v11_Annotations_SubjectPhenotypesDS.txt")
```

# cleaning sample df

create donor ID column
(https://sites.google.com/broadinstitute.org/gtex-faqs/home?pli=1&authuser=0)
```{r}
samples_clean <- samples %>%
  separate_wider_delim(SAMPID, delim = "-", names = c('ID_1', 'ID_2', 'ID_3', 'ID_4', 'ID_5'),
                       too_few = "align_start", too_many = "merge",
                       cols_remove = F) %>%
  mutate(donor_ID = paste(ID_1, ID_2, sep = '-'))
```

keep only samples that 1. are LV and 2.are in the count file
```{r}
samples_clean <- samples_clean %>%
  filter(SMTSD == 'Heart - Left Ventricle') %>%
  filter(SAMPID %in% colnames(counts))
```

keeping only RIN >= 7
```{r}
samples_clean <- samples_clean %>%
  filter(SMRIN >= 7)
```

# making subset

binding samples and subject info
```{r}
samples_and_subjects_clean <- samples_clean %>%
  left_join(subjects, join_by('donor_ID' == 'SUBJID'))
```

```{r}
summary(as.factor(samples_and_subjects_clean$SEX))
```
157 men (SEX == 1) and 100 women (SEX == 2)

keeping 10 men and 10 women at random for this example
```{r}
samples_and_subjects_clean$SEX <- as.factor(samples_and_subjects_clean$SEX)

samples_and_subjects_clean_subset <- samples_and_subjects_clean %>%
  group_by(SEX) %>%
  slice_sample(n=10) %>%
  ungroup()

counts_subset <- counts[, c('Name', samples_and_subjects_clean_subset$SAMPID)]
```

saving the subset data
```{r}
dir.create("data/raw", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

save(samples_and_subjects_clean_subset, file = "data/raw/samples_and_subjects_clean_subset.RData")
save(counts_subset, file = "data/raw/counts_subset.RData")
```
